definitions.explanation: The branch of a country's military forces that conducts aerial warfare. Japan's equivalent is the {航空自衛隊|こうくうじえいたい} (Air Self-Defense Force).

examples.japanese: {空軍|くうぐん}⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an air force base.

examples.japanese: {空軍|くうぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パイロット→パイロット：00339_pairotto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become an air force pilot.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空軍|くうぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: That country is putting effort into modernizing its air force.

notes:
{空軍|くうぐん} refers to the air force branch of a country's military. It is composed of ⟦{空|くう}→空〜：03949_kuu⟧ (sky/air) + ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (military/armed forces).

THE THREE BRANCHES:
- ⟦{陸軍|りくぐん}→陸軍：19089_rikugun⟧: army (land forces)
- ⟦{海軍|かいぐん}→海軍：13289_kaigun⟧: navy (sea forces)
- {空軍|くうぐん}: air force

JAPAN'S CASE:
Japan does not officially have an {空軍|くうぐん}. Under the post-war constitution, Japan's military is organized as ⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧ (Self-Defense Forces). The air force equivalent is the {航空自衛隊|こうくうじえいたい} (Air Self-Defense Force). {空軍|くうぐん} is used when referring to other countries' air forces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空軍|くうぐん}⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧: air force base
- {空軍|くうぐん}{力|りょく}: air power
- {空軍|くうぐん}⟦パイロット→パイロット：00339_pairotto⟧: air force pilot
